svg.title: ConstArt — Art, science and human imagination
svg.desc: Constantine Artemiou, a multidisciplinary creator from Greece. UI/UX Designer, Creative Developer and Digital Artist. An original geometric C and A monogram combines a calligraphic curve, architectural construction lines and a rising triangular form, expressing the meeting of art, geometry, philosophy and technology.

g.aria-label: UI/UX Designer · Creative Developer · Digital Artist
